meta.name: azure-reliability
meta.description: Assess and improve the reliability posture of PaaS Applications (Azure Functions and Azure App Service). Scans deployed resources for zone redundancy, ZRS storage, health probes, and multi-region failover. Presents a feature-pivoted checklist, then drives staged remediation (CLI or IaC patches) end-to-end with user confirmation. WHEN: "assess reliability", "check reliability", "zone redundant", "multi-region failover", "high availability", "disaster recovery", "single points of failure", "reliability posture", "resiliency".

copy.tagline: 评估并修复 Azure 应用的单点故障与灾难恢复短板
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的 Azure 应用可能缺少区域冗余或健康探测
copy.tagline_en: Assess and fix single points of failure and disaster recovery gaps in Azure apps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your Azure app may lack zone redundancy or health probes

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会检查你的 Azure Functions 和 App Service 应用，扫描区域冗余、存储冗余、健康探测、多区域故障转移等可靠性项，输出按功能分类的检查表，并在你确认后分阶段用命令行或 IaC 补丁修复。
howto.when: 当你说出“assess reliability”“check reliability”“zone redundant”等关键词，或要求检查高可用、灾备、单点故障时触发。

say.text: 帮我评估我的 Function App 的可靠性
say.note: 会扫描并生成可靠性检查表

say.text: 检查我的资源组的可靠性
让我的应用支持多区域故障转移
say.note: 会先给方案，确认后才动手

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will inspect your Azure Functions and App Service apps for zone redundancy, storage redundancy, health probes, and multi-region failover, then present a feature-based checklist. After your confirmation, it will apply fixes in stages via CLI commands or IaC patches.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "assess reliability", "check reliability", "zone redundant", or ask for high availability, disaster recovery, or single-point-of-failure checks.

say_en.text: Assess the reliability of my Function App
say_en.note: Scans and generates a reliability checklist

say_en.text: Check the reliability of my resource group
say_en.note: Lists reliability gaps for App Service and Functions

say_en.text: Set up multi-region failover for my app
say_en.note: Shows a plan first and waits for confirmation
